notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Cabal Ritual by paying {1}{B}, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Izzet Chronarch and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Izzet Chronarch tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Cabal Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
